stopSim: Sim mode: does not control the real robot
portPickerHint: Serial port to connect on. Auto-detect uses the port the daemon last connected on, then discovery. Locked while connected: disconnect first to change it.
controlFrequencyFixedHint: Fixed controller configuration (no query API; reference only)
clearFaultsDesc: Send fault clear command to joint servo drives (e.g. after overcurrent / overtemp recovery)
clearStopDesc: Release controller software interlock triggered by E-Stop button or overspeed protection
homePoseTitle: Move to recommended ready pose Home
zeroPoseTitle: Move to zero pose (all axes 0 rad)

errors.notConnected: Robot arm not connected: connect the local daemon and the arm from the top bar first
errors.unknownCommand: The local daemon does not support this command (not in its whitelist)
errors.motionBusy: Robot arm is busy with another motion, please wait for completion or stop current motion
errors.commandTimeout: Command execution timed out: the local daemon did not return a response in time, please check robot status
errors.transportError: Communication with the robot arm failed, please check USB connection, device power and the local daemon
errors.firmwareMismatch: Firmware version does not match the local daemon, please update the controller firmware or the app
errors.motorFault: Motor fault: {{message}}, please check power supply or clear faults
errors.motionTimeout: Motion timed out: the controller did not finish within the expected time, please check robot status
errors.badMessage: Protocol error talking to the local daemon: {{message}}
errors.portChangeWhileConnected: The arm is already connected on another serial port: press Disconnect, then connect the new port
errors.disconnectFailed: Disconnect was not confirmed: {{message}}. The arm may still be connected — please retry
errors.notEnabled: Robot arm is not enabled — enable it before commanding motion
errors.cartUnsupported: This firmware was built without cartesian planning: linear motion and cartesian jog are unavailable, use joint space instead
errors.jointLimitsFallback: Could not read the joint soft limits from the controller; the sliders fell back to built-in ranges
errors.notActivated: This arm is not activated, so the firmware refuses to enable it: open Settings → Activation, fill in the registration form and submit it
errors.activationMustDisable: The firmware only accepts the license record while the arm is disarmed: press Disarm, then submit again
errors.activationWriteRejected: The firmware refused this write (already activated, credential mismatch and write failure share one code, so the code cannot tell them apart): press Refresh to read the state; if it is still not activated, check the device UID and request a new credential
errors.activationUnconfigured: The local daemon has no activation service address: start it with --activation-url
errors.activationUnreachable: Cannot reach the activation service: check this machine's network
errors.activationNotFound: The activation service has no license for this machine: send its device UID to your supplier so they can record it, then submit again
errors.activationRateLimited: The activation service refused this request (too many requests): try again later
errors.activationMaintenance: The activation service is under maintenance: retry later
errors.activationConsentRequired: Tick the consent checkbox before sending
errors.activationMissingContact: The registration details are incomplete: every field marked * is required
errors.activationBadName: The name is not acceptable: 2-32 characters of letters only, no digits
errors.activationBadPhone: The phone number is not acceptable: an 11-digit number is required
errors.activationBadEmail: The email address is not acceptable: the format is wrong
errors.activationContactTooLong: One registration field is too long: check the length of name, phone, organisation, email, WeChat ID, region, industry and purpose
errors.activationBadResponse: The activation service returned an unusable reply: retry later
errors.licenseUnreadable: That license file is not usable: make sure it is the lic.json your supplier issued
errors.licenseUnsupportedFormat: The license file is newer than this host application: upgrade it, or use a license that matches
errors.licenseUidMismatch: This license belongs to a different machine: use the one issued for this arm's UID
errors.gripperNotConnected: Gripper is not connected: connect it on the gripper page first
errors.gripperNotEnabled: Gripper is not enabled — press Enable on the gripper panel first
errors.gripperLinkError: The gripper's CAN interface is unavailable: {{message}}
errors.gripperFaultActive: The gripper drive reports a fault: {{message}} — clear it once the cause is gone
errors.gripperCalibration: The gripper's calibration does not allow this: {{message}}
errors.gripperEstopped: The gripper's stop is latched: remove the cause, then reset it
errors.gripperBusy: The gripper is running another long operation (calibration); wait for it
errors.activationServerError: The activation service returned an error: try again later, or contact your supplier if it keeps failing
errors.activationInvalidRequest: The activation service rejected these registration details: check the fields marked * and submit again (if it keeps happening, the website's field rules have changed)
errors.activationCodeRequired: The activation service requires an order number or activation code: upgrade Studio, or contact your supplier
errors.activationInvalidUid: The device UID is not a valid 24-character hex string: reconnect the arm and try again
errors.activationDeviceUidUnavailable: Cannot read the arm's license record, so this machine cannot be confirmed and nothing was sent: check the USB link and retry
errors.activationFirmwareUnsupported: This firmware has no activation support (1.8.0 or newer is required): update the firmware
errors.upgradeBusy: A firmware update is running: the device is in the bootloader, wait for it to finish (or cancel) before doing anything else
errors.firmwareImageRejected: This firmware image cannot be used: {{message}}
errors.firmwareImageUnreadable: This image cannot be read: it is neither valid Intel HEX nor a .bin. Ask your supplier for the official .hex
errors.firmwareImageNotAtBase: The image does not start at 0x08000000, which is the only place the application runs from: check that you picked the firmware and not another segment
errors.firmwareImageTooLarge: The image is larger than the controller's 1 MB of flash: check that you picked the right file
errors.firmwareImageCoversProtected: The image covers the sectors holding the licence and the factory calibration, which cannot be restored once erased: this image must not be used; ask your supplier for the correct firmware
errors.firmwareConfirmRequired: Not confirmed: the update disarms the arm first, and an unsupported arm will sag
errors.firmwareEngineUnavailable: This machine has no usable USB flashing engine: {{message}} (pyusb and libusb are required; on Windows the ST WinUSB driver is needed too)
errors.firmwareArmEnabled: The arm did not disarm, so the update was stopped: entering the bootloader while armed lets the motors go and the arm sags
errors.firmwareDfuNotEntered: The controller did not accept the request to enter the bootloader (the registration was revoked or never executed): the arm is unchanged, confirm it is disarmed and retry
errors.firmwareDfuAbsent: No DFU device (0483:DF11) appeared after entering the bootloader: check the USB cable; Windows needs the ST WinUSB driver
errors.firmwareDfuPermission: Cannot open the DFU device (permission denied): the board is in the bootloader, but this user cannot access it. On Linux it needs a udev rule: SUBSYSTEM=="usb", ATTR{idVendor}=="0483", ATTR{idProduct}=="df11", MODE="0666"
errors.firmwareFlashFailed: Flashing failed: {{message}}. The affected sectors were erased back to blank where possible, so you can retry; repeated failures need an SWD probe
errors.firmwareReconnectFailed: The firmware was written and verified by read-back, but the controller could not be reconnected: {{message}}
errors.firmwareCancelled: The update was cancelled (cancelling has no effect once flashing has started)
